radius_button.label: Bulb radius, button
radius_button.description: Radius of the bulb at the base of the stipe on the button, the stipe above it is about half as thick

radius_open.label: Bulb radius, open
radius_open.description: Radius of the bulb at the base of the stipe on the open mushroom, the stipe above it is about half as thick

color_button.label: Veil, button
color_button.description: The white universal veil that covers the button, the warts are what is left of it

color_open.label: Veil, open
color_open.description: The warts of the open cap, they yellow a little with age

ring_button.label: Ring height, button
ring_button.description: Where the veil holds on the stipe on the button, as a share of the stipe from its base

ring_open.label: Ring height, open
ring_open.description: Where the ring sits on the open mushroom, as a share of the stipe from its base: real rings sit in the upper third

spacing.label: Wart spacing
spacing.description: How far apart the warts are, as a share of the cap radius, so they move apart as the cap grows

height.label: Wart height
height.description: How far the warts stand above the red cuticle in the middle of the cap, they flatten towards the margin

bulb.label: Bulb
bulb.description: How much of the stipe the bulb takes, from its base

length.label: Length
length.description: How far the rims stand out from the bulb of the grown mushroom
